s1.ptxt: Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Drain coolant.
Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover.
Remove front bumper.
Remove front bumper lower absorber, front end upper cover and front end lower cover.
Disconnect radiator inlet hose (1) from radiator.
Remove hood lock member cover (2).
Remove discharge hose bracket bolt (3).
Disconnect radiator cooling main fan motor connector (1) and radiator cooling sub fan motor connector (2).
Disconnect intercooler outlet hose No.2 (1) from intercooler outlet pipe.
Disconnect intercooler inlet hose No.1 (2) from turbocharger outlet air pipe.
Remove radiator support bracket bolts (3).
Remove condenser upper and lower bolts.

attention4.ptxt: The A/C condenser assembly may be damaged if it hits against or interferes with other parts.
Suspend the removed A/C condenser assembly in a place where no damage will be caused during removal and installation of the radiator.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect radiator outlet hose (1).
Support front lower crossmember (1) with jack (2).
Remove front lower crossmember bolts (3), and then lower jack and remove radiator, intercooler with front lower crossmember.
Remove radiator and intercooler from front lower crossmember.
Remove intercooler from radiator.
Remove radiator cooling fan assembly.
Remove radiator left bracket (1) and radiator right bracket (2) from radiator, if necessary.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Tighten radiator support bracket bolts (1) to specified torque.
If there is matchmark on each of hose and pipe, install the hose aligning matchmark on hose with matchmark on pipe and then install each clamp in proper position.
